Author: Aki
Name: AutoMarket
Punchline: Plan a shopping cart, travel efficiently, and buy live market listings.
Description: Compare Universalis listings across your entire region, cross-checked against a local cache of listings you've personally verified live, plan target quantities and budgets, group a multi-item cart by world, and use Lifestream to travel and buy safe live fallbacks. Optionally uses Allagan Tools to subtract what you already own from the target quantity. Includes gil/inventory checks, progress, and persistent purchase history. Commands: /automarket, /am. Requires Lifestream.
